allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Two neurotics, working for a suicide hotline on the night of Christmas Eve, get caught up in a catastrophe when a pregnant woman, her abusive boyfriend, and a cross-dresser visit their office.

facts.overview: Two neurotics, working for a suicide hotline on the night of Christmas Eve, get caught up in a catastrophe when a pregnant woman, her abusive boyfriend, and a cross-dresser visit their office.
facts.title: Santa Claus Is a Stinker

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: When clashing outsiders collide in a single room on a holiday night, how long can the hotline workers keep total catastrophe at bay?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: On Christmas Eve, two neurotic volunteers staffing a suicide hotline find their shift spiraling out of control when an unpredictable mix of eccentric visitors descends upon their cramped office.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast, chaotic, and lighthearted; an easy-watching 88-minute comedy built on relentless momentum and group friction.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Jean-Marie Poiré delivers a fast-paced French farce where holiday cheer is upended by manic escalation and sharp, unapologetic situational humor.
